title: Question To Chart
description: Frames the survey question beside a staggered response distribution so the evidence stays tied to the prompt.

defaultProps.question: Which part of the experience creates the most value?

title: Response Distribution
description: Turns response shares into an animated donut and a readable legend for fast survey readouts.

defaultProps.question: How confident are you recommending the workflow?

title: Segment Compare
description: Compares response distributions across audience segments with parallel animated bars.

defaultProps.question: What would make this a habit?

title: NPS Reveal
description: Builds a net promoter score from promoter, passive, and detractor shares with a measured count-up.

defaultProps.question: How likely are you to recommend this to a teammate?

title: Sentiment Split
description: Separates positive, neutral, and negative sentiment into an immediately scannable three-card readout.

defaultProps.question: How did the new experience make you feel?

title: Open Text Wall
description: Reveals anonymous open-text responses as a paced wall of respondent voices.

defaultProps.question: What is the one thing you would keep?
comments: It finally feels simple enough to use every week.
The biggest win is knowing what to do next.
I can see the value before I learn the whole system.
The workflow is clear, but still leaves room for my style.
defaultProps.methodology: Open text · responses lightly edited for length

title: Response Rate
description: Uses a progress ring and fieldwork notes to give response rate and denominator context together.

defaultProps.question: How many invited respondents completed the survey?

title: Trend By Wave
description: Shows a survey measure rising or falling across fieldwork waves with labeled points and baseline context.

defaultProps.question: How confident are respondents after each release wave?

title: Top Insight
description: Elevates one qualified insight while keeping its supporting percentages visible beside it.

defaultProps.question: What most predicts whether people return?
defaultProps.insight: Clarity is the strongest predictor of whether people return.
defaultProps.methodology: Directional association · not a causal claim

title: Survey Recap
description: Closes a survey story with sample, top signal, and next move cards plus methodology context.

defaultProps.question: What should the team do with this signal?
defaultProps.insight: Make the first useful moment obvious, then let people explore.
defaultProps.methodology: Read percentages with sample size and question wording in view.
